title: Callers can choose their own model fallback chain
summary:
Callers gained model fallback chains, sandboxes became easier to compare, and completed generation jobs got better at finding their way back to waiting callers.

The `model` field now accepts up to four comma-separated model IDs or aliases. On retryable upstream failures, generation tries them in order, including on audio routes and `/v1/messages`. Every entry must share a category and support the requested endpoint. Each attempt uses that model's pricing, permissions, balance check, and rate limit.

A searchable Sandboxes tab now shows five E2B and Azure templates with their sizes, hourly prices, 720-hour monthly estimates, launch discount, and create commands. The sandbox pricing API also returns each template's name, provider, size, and disk size.

Pixelsprite ai was added for pixel-art game assets and image editing. DynaSpark AI was added as a multimodal assistant for text, code, images, video, data, and documents.

daily.title: Choose your model fallbacks
daily.text: Set `model` to up to four comma-separated model IDs or aliases. If an upstream attempt fails in a retryable way, the API tries the next eligible model in order. Entries must share a category and support the requested endpoint. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Compare sandbox templates
daily.text: The searchable Sandboxes tab shows five E2B and Azure templates, with sizes, hourly prices, 720-hour monthly estimates, the 75% launch discount, and a `polli sandbox create` command for each. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: More sandbox pricing details
daily.text: `GET /alpha/e2b/pricing` now includes each template's name, provider, size, and `diskSizeMB` alongside its existing fields. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
